author: macro-strategist-cyrus-daruwalla
robustness: sign and rough magnitude STABLE under drop-one; excluding 2008 GFC actually STRENGTHENS the rho (-0.50 vs -0.25 full-sample) -- the relationship is not an artifact of that single crisis. Excluding 2022 selloff leaves rho unchanged (that era post-dates the last usable 5Y-forward window, n identical).
observed_range: richness_index observed range in this sample (2007-2025, expanding-window EY z-score) is ~47 (Nov-2008 trough) to ~122 (calmer bull-market stretches) -- it NEVER reached the Principal's illustrative 160+ 'crash-risk' band in this history. Likely cause: the expanding std used for the z-score is inflated by the 2008 outlier for all subsequent years, structurally compressing later readings toward the mean -- so this construction under-detects genuine bubble-side overvaluation post-2009 (e.g. 2017-18 midcap mania, 2021 post-COVID rally) even though it correctly flagged the 2008 cheap extreme. Flagged as a real limitation, not fabricated data.
honesty_note: n=167, low-power by design (index-level, 5Y overlapping windows). Judged on economic logic + drop-one per task brief, not t/DSR. Same asymmetry as 1Y: return-direction signal is real and robust; crash-magnitude-specific correlations are weak/wrong-signed.
verdict: PARTIAL SUPPORT -- fwd-return direction robust and if anything strengthens ex-2008; crash-magnitude claim not confirmed; richness index construction under-ranges on the expensive side post-2009 (calibration caveat, not a kill).
